metadata.title: Walmart’s Slump Makes the Stock a Buy<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Walmart’s Slump Makes the Stock a Buy
The company still dominates retail and is growing ancillary revenue streams.
The world’s largest bricks-and-mortar retailer hit a wall last month. That won’t last.
